notes:
Account summary:
- Thriftline operates a high-volume ecommerce support channel (order/status/returns) with heavy cost pressure.
- Primary objective: maximize chat deflection via robust bot + fast agent assist for fallback.
- Volume: ~400k inbound messages/day; peak traffic during promotions up to 3-4x baseline.
- Current bot stack: rule + intent classifier; looking to replace with LLM-based deflection + tool-calling for order lookups.
- Key metrics they care about: deflection rate (target 60-70%), p95 latency (target < 350ms for deflected flows), cost per deflected conversation (target <$0.06), accuracy on NLU intents (no more than 3% regression vs current).
Technical priorities / requirements:
- Need predictable unit economics at scale: want suggestions on batching settings, cache policies, and quantization profiles that balance cost vs accuracy.
- Must support VPC connection for sensitive user PII; legal requires data residency in EU for EU traffic.
- Tool-calling: require stable, idempotent connector patterns to their order system (GraphQL) and audit logs for tool calls.
- Reliability: graceful degradation during spikes — fallback to smaller models or synthetic summaries to preserve SLA.
POC notes and observations:
- Prefix/KV caching reduced token consumption by ~28% on sample runs for repeated order-status queries.
- Quantized model path (8-bit) showed ~35% cost savings but introduced slight ambiguity on long-tail slot extraction. SE recommended hybrid: quantized for deflection + fp16 for tool-calling.
- Continuous batching helpful during promotions but must be tuned to keep tail latency within acceptable bounds (p95 target).
Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need to make sure deflection saves more than it costs — if it costs us more per chat, it's a non-starter." — Mia Ramos, Head of Support.
- "Compliance and auditability are table stakes; any solution must integrate with our existing SSO and KMS." — CTO (internal).
Open items for Redwood:
- Provide end-to-end cost model: tokens, KB cache hit assumptions, batching latency impact, estimated ARR ROI at 2x/4x peak.
- Detailed quantization accuracy report on their sample corpus (intent extraction and slot fill).
- Draft SOW with EU residency clause and data processing addendum.
Next steps (short):
- SE to deliver perf/accuracy matrix comparing: baseline model, quantized model, and hybrid approach (due 2026-03-20).
- Pricing: owner to send dedicated reserved pricing + Optimize recommendations by 2026-03-20.
- Legal: Redwood to share SOC2 + draft DPA.
